clue.text: Chargers get drunk, grabbing Loki's girl, and old god's covered with cheese

indicators.note: to grab something is to hold it in your clutches, so the drunk word closes around the girl

parts.note: tight is slang for drunk
in Norse myth Hel, ruler of the underworld, is Loki's daughter

indicators.note: something covered with a layer sits inside it, so the god goes inside the cheese

parts.note: a soft French cheese
Gad was an ancient Semitic god of fortune

explanation.surface: Rowdy football fans called the Chargers get drunk, mob a mythical goddess and smear an old deity with cheese.
explanation.walkthrough: The Chargers are not a sports team: the definition points to Tennyson's famous cavalry charge at Balaclava.
explanation.definitionFit: The Light Brigade were the cavalry who made the doomed charge in the Crimean War, so they are literally chargers.

clue.text: Shut up about a time to be green

indicators.note: about means around, so the walling-in word surrounds the other letters

parts.note: to immure is to wall someone in
taken as written
T is the abbreviation for time

explanation.surface: Being locked away for a spell would make anyone go green.
explanation.definitionFit: Green describes someone inexperienced or not fully developed, a common figurative synonym for childish youth.

clue.text: A love for indigo

parts.note: taken as written
love is a zero score in tennis, and nil is zero

explanation.surface: A fondness for a deep blue colour.
explanation.definitionFit: Anil is the West Indian shrub that yields the blue dye, and also a name for that dye itself.

clue.text: Glistening passions half-roused inwardly

indicators.note: inwardly places the shortened word inside the word for desires

parts.note: lusts are strong desires

indicators.note: half asks for only the front portion of the following word

parts.note: the first three of its six letters

explanation.surface: Desires stirred up from within leave someone with shining eyes.
explanation.definitionFit: Lustrous means having a sheen or gloss, so glistening is a close synonym.

clue.text: Incompletely train up as drink carrier

indicators.note: incompletely means the word for train lacks its final letter

parts.note: to train someone is to teach them
taken as written

explanation.surface: Half-heartedly training someone to work as a waiter.
explanation.definitionFit: A cup for tea is a small vessel that holds a hot beverage, a playful description of its job.

clue.text: Game casserole almost cooked

indicators.note: cooked suggests ingredients mixed and transformed, so the letters are rearranged
almost means the dish's name stops one letter short

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A stew of game meat that has been nearly cooked through.
explanation.walkthrough: Game looks like the meat in the casserole, but it is the definition for a sport.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacrosse is a team sport played with netted sticks, so it is a kind of game.

clue.text: Exciting excursion for a fellow in women's clothing

indicators.note: in places the letters inside the garment

parts.note: the draped garment worn by women in South Asia
F is the abbreviation for fellow
taken as written

explanation.surface: A thrilling outing for a man in drag.
explanation.definitionFit: A safari is an expedition to observe or hunt wild animals, a thrilling kind of trip.

clue.text: Artist unexpectedly buys Cornish home

indicators.note: unexpectedly suggests things turning out in a surprising arrangement

parts.note: taken as written, fifteen letters

explanation.surface: A painter surprises everyone by purchasing a house in Cornwall.
explanation.definitionFit: Bosch was the Netherlandish painter of the Garden of Earthly Delights, a famous artist.

clue.text: Little fellow's house sending many a relative round the bend

indicators.note: round puts the relative around the curved letter

parts.note: HO is the abbreviation for house
M is the Roman numeral for a thousand, a lot
an uncle is a relative
a U-bend is shaped like the letter

explanation.surface: A small man's household is driving a relative mad.
explanation.walkthrough: Round the bend is British slang for crazy, but here UNCLE literally goes round U.
explanation.definitionFit: A homuncule, or homunculus, is a tiny human being, so a diminutive man.

clue.text: Foreign friend holding a square violin

indicators.note: holding means the friend's word wraps around the other letters

parts.note: ami is French for friend
taken as written
a T-square is a drawing instrument

explanation.surface: An overseas companion holding an old-fashioned violin.
explanation.definitionFit: The Amati family of Cremona made celebrated violins, so an Amati is one of their instruments.

clue.text: Grassland on which navy loses heart to flier

indicators.note: losing heart means the middle letter of the navy word goes

parts.note: a lea is a meadow
a fleet is a navy

explanation.surface: A field where sailors lose courage before a pilot.
explanation.definitionFit: A flier, or flyer, is a printed handout, the same thing as a small promotional sheet.

clue.text: Return of fabled bird vexed Scottish pirate

indicators.note: return means the bird's name is read back the other way

parts.note: the roc is the giant bird of Arabian legend
sair is the Scots form of sore, meaning annoyed

explanation.surface: A legendary bird comes back to annoy a Scottish buccaneer.
explanation.definitionFit: A corsair was a privateer of the Barbary coast, so a seagoing raider.

clue.text: Leave note on painful condition

parts.note: to go is to leave
ut is the old name for the first note of the scale, now doh

explanation.surface: Someone leaves a note about a sore ailment.
explanation.definitionFit: Gout is a form of arthritis causing intensely sore swollen joints, a painful condition.

clue.text: Way finder with an atom of sympathy

parts.note: a compass finds direction
an ion is a charged atom

explanation.surface: A navigator with a touch of sympathy for others.
explanation.definitionFit: Compassion is concern for the suffering of others, which is essentially the same as sympathy.

clue.text: Container for drink — mother's ruin?

indicators.note: ruin wrecks the word, so its letters fall into a new order

parts.note: taken as written, ignoring the apostrophe

explanation.surface: A flask for drink holding mother's ruin, that is gin.
explanation.walkthrough: Mother's ruin is British slang for gin, which suits the drink container, but here ruin is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A Thermos is a vacuum flask that keeps hot or cold beverages at temperature.

clue.text: Business person's Gallic sea shanty?

parts.note: mer is French for sea
a sea shanty is a sailors' work song or chant

explanation.surface: A trader's French sailing song.
explanation.walkthrough: Sea shanty reads as one phrase, but sea belongs with Gallic and shanty stands alone; the question mark flags shanty as an example of a chant.
explanation.definitionFit: A merchant buys and sells goods for profit, so a trader in business.

clue.text: Proposition third parties receiving aggregate

indicators.note: receiving means the word for third parties takes something inside

parts.note: them refers to others, the third person plural
ore is a mineral aggregate from which metal is extracted

explanation.surface: An offer to outside parties to take a stake in a combined total.
explanation.definitionFit: In mathematics a theorem is a statement to be proved, a formal proposition.

clue.text: Sultry old solver's kept below

indicators.note: kept means the archaic possessive holds the word for beneath

parts.note: thy is the archaic form of your, and the solver is you
a synonym

explanation.surface: An elderly crossword fan is kept hot and bothered underneath.
explanation.definitionFit: Hot humid weather often comes before a storm, so sultry air is heavy and threatening a thunderstorm.

clue.text: Original recipe to overlap with admonition

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for recipe, as on a prescription

indicators.note: something original is newly made, so the letters are put into a new order

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: A chef is told off for a novel recipe whose ingredients overlap.
explanation.definitionFit: Reproval is a rebuke or scolding, the same thing as an admonition.

clue.text: Strange free goal in strange communal decision

indicators.note: strange suggests the word is made odd by being jumbled

parts.note: taken as written

indicators.note: in places the preceding letters inside the word for odd

parts.note: rum is British slang for odd or peculiar
an end is an aim or goal

explanation.surface: An odd free goal is awarded in a peculiar vote by the whole community.
explanation.walkthrough: Strange appears twice with two jobs: first it jumbles the next word, then it stands for RUM.
explanation.definitionFit: A referendum is a direct vote by the whole electorate on a single question, a decision taken collectively.

clue.text: Stuff about one article from the Sun, reportedly

indicators.note: about means the word for stuff goes around the other letters

parts.note: to stuff is to fill
I is the Roman numeral for one
the indefinite article

explanation.surface: Padding a piece copied from a tabloid newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: The Sun is a British tabloid, but in the definition its sound stands for son, and reportedly signals that sound.
explanation.definitionFit: Filial means relating to a son or daughter, so coming from a son, which is what the Sun sounds like.

clue.text: Remove number beforehand and slip into oblivion

indicators.note: beforehand means the abbreviation for number is placed in front

parts.note: No. is the abbreviation for number
to doff is to take off a hat or garment

explanation.surface: Take off a number in advance and drift away.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed answer NODDFF is a misprint; the wordplay and definition give NOD OFF.
explanation.definitionFit: To nod off is to fall asleep, drifting into unconsciousness, a gentle kind of oblivion.

clue.text: Love to shove Unfinished Symphony, say

indicators.note: unfinished means the word for shove lacks its last letter

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O
to shove is to push

explanation.surface: A lover pushes Schubert's Unfinished Symphony on others.
explanation.walkthrough: Unfinished Symphony reads as Schubert's famous work, but Unfinished belongs to the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: An opus is a numbered musical composition, and a symphony is one example of such a work.

clue.text: Festival owned by knight

parts.note: a gala is a festive occasion
to have had something is to have owned it

explanation.surface: A fete belonging to a knight.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Galahad is the purest of King Arthur's Round Table warriors, the one who found the Grail.

clue.text: Battered old tabloid model's gone on the game

indicators.note: battered means knocked about, so the letters are knocked into a new order
gone means the letter for model is taken away

parts.note: O is the abbreviation for old
taken as written
Ford's Model T car

explanation.surface: A worn-out old tabloid model has gone into prostitution.
explanation.walkthrough: On the game is British slang for working as a prostitute, but here the game is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Diabolo is a juggling toy, a spool spun and tossed on a string held between two sticks.

clue.text: Plant held up by Samurai

indicators.note: in a down clue up means reading the letters from bottom to top
held means the letters are contained within the next word

parts.note: the middle letters

explanation.surface: A plant raised by a Japanese warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: The arum is a lily-like plant with a hooded spathe, such as cuckoo-pint.

clue.text: Depicted looking stressed

definitions.meaning: second meaning: haggard and tired in the face

explanation.surface: Portrayed as appearing anxious.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is the past participle of sketch-making and also an adjective for a pinched, strained face.

clue.text: It's unimaginative of ants to take heart from gulag

indicators.note: to take means the ants word takes the middle letters inside

parts.note: formic means relating to ants, as in formic acid

indicators.note: heart asks for the central letters of the next word

parts.note: the middle three of its five letters

explanation.surface: Ants raiding a prison camp would be a dull idea.
explanation.definitionFit: Formulaic work follows a set pattern or formula, so it lacks originality and is dull.
